intro: Moon Priestess Amara is a night elf priestess stationed along the main road west of Dolanaar in Teldrassil. Flanked by loyal huntress guards, she keeps watch over the woodland pathways connecting the heart of the bough to the capital city of Darnassus.

p: Stationed at a quiet wayside post west of Dolanaar, Moon Priestess Amara represents both the spiritual authority of the Sisterhood of Elune and the practical vigilance required to keep Teldrassil's roadways secure. She travels and watches with two huntress companions, Nhemai and Yaeliura. To travelers journeying westward, Amara acts as a guiding hand, directing adventurers along the road toward Darnassus and tasking those with burdened spirits to seek out paths of redemption.
